vc_checking.summary: All seven cleaned manual obligations are semantically provable from the current annotation-approved dispatch specification and DLL model. The implementation witnesses share one decomposition/reassembly family; the two derived-call witnesses additionally use the dispatch definition and, for the member case, DLL membership exclusion of the sentinel.

vc_shape.pre_exists: The xizi_dll opening supplies sentinel first/last; the member branch additionally chooses the first occurrence cut nodes_before/nodes_after and node links.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Either the sentinel-open layout, or sentinel links plus a prefix segment, queried-node links, and suffix segment.
vc_shape.post_pure: Sentinel: node=head and dispatch=first_value(nodes). Member: nodes=before++node::after, freshness of before, dispatch=first_value(after), node non-null, and node distinct from head.
vc_shape.post_exists: Choose the opened DLL endpoints; in the member branch choose the first-occurrence cut and the queried node's next/prev fields.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Unfold anchor. For node=head choose the left post disjunct and the endpoints from xizi_dll_open. For In node nodes, choose the first occurrence before/after, split the DLL segment at that occurrence, and choose the exposed node_next/node_prev.
witnesses.space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open. In the member branch perform an induction on nodes_before to split xizi_dllseg; use separation of sentinel links and queried-node links to establish node<>head. Resources then match the second post disjunct by cancellation.
witnesses.pure_plan: The first-occurrence lemma supplies nodes decomposition and prefix freshness. Unfold xizi_double_link_next_anchor and xizi_double_link_next_dispatch_value; prefix freshness computes xizi_double_link_next_value to first_value(after), while spatial segment/link facts supply node<>0 and node<>head.
premise_discharge: In node nodes is the member arm of the anchor precondition.
Prefix freshness follows by choosing the first list occurrence.
node<>0 and node<>head follow from the nonempty dllseg cell and disjoint ownership of head/node link fields.
dispatch=first_value(after) follows by unfolding dispatch off-head and applying the first-occurrence next-value equation.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Introduces the same first-occurrence, segment-split, distinct-links, and dispatch helpers used by the return and derived-member witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Head next/prev stores plus xizi_dllseg first head head last nodes, with first=head.
vc_shape.post_spatial: xizi_dll head nodes in the selected first Coq-disjunct.
vc_shape.post_exists: none when selecting the first Coq-disjunct.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first Coq-level disjunct. The segment starts and stops at head, so nodes=nil; close the head links and empty segment back to xizi_dll.
witnesses.space_plan: Regroup the two head stores as xizi_dll_links and apply xizi_dll_close.
witnesses.pure_plan: A dllseg whose node equals stop forces nodes=nil. Then first_value nil=0 and PreH4 yields dispatch=0.
premise_discharge: nodes=nil follows by destructing nodes and ruling out the nonempty dllseg branch's node<>stop guard.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Sentinel-return base case of the same segment reconstruction family.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel links, prefix segment to the queried member, queried-member links with node_next=head, and suffix segment from head to head.
vc_shape.pre_pure: nodes=before++node::after, freshness, dispatch=first_value(after), non-nullness, and node_next=head.
vc_shape.post_spatial: xizi_dll head nodes in the selected first Coq-disjunct.
vc_shape.post_exists: none when selecting the first Coq-disjunct.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first Coq-level disjunct; the suffix segment begins at its stop, hence after=nil.
witnesses.space_plan: Regroup stores into sentinel/member xizi_dll_links, join prefix + member + empty suffix into one dllseg, then apply xizi_dll_close.
witnesses.pure_plan: node_next=head makes the suffix segment start=stop, forcing after=nil. PreH5 and first_value nil=0 yield dispatch=0.
premise_discharge: head<>0 and node<>0 are PreH2 and PreH6.
after=nil comes from the suffix dllseg and PreH1.
The join side conditions follow from the stated non-nullness and disjoint owned link fields.
witnesses.grouping_reason: End-of-list member return uses the shared dllseg join helper and dispatch/first-value facts.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Either the full split DLL layout, or its nonempty-suffix unfolding with node_next's links exposed.
vc_shape.pre_pure: nodes=before++node::after, freshness, dispatch=first_value(after), node_next<>head, and non-nullness.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The second branch exposes after=node_next::l0 and next.
vc_shape.post_spatial: xizi_dll head nodes, or the corresponding rejoined dllseg in the alternate entailment.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first Coq-level disjunct. Use node_next<>head to show the suffix list is nonempty and begins with node_next.
witnesses.space_plan: Use the first-value fact from xizi_dllseg node_next ... after, join prefix/member/suffix, and close with sentinel links.
witnesses.pure_plan: The nonempty suffix segment entails node_next=first_value(after). Combine with PreH5 to obtain node_next=dispatch.
premise_discharge: node_next<>head is PreH1 and licenses xizi_dllseg_unfold/first-value extraction.
head<>0 and member node<>0 are PreH2 and PreH6.
The join side conditions follow from those facts and disjoint link ownership.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Non-final member return is the nonempty-suffix counterpart of return_wit_2 with the same join helper.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel next/prev stores and xizi_dllseg first head head last nodes, with first<>head.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The alternate generated entailment exposes nodes=first::l0 and the first node's links.
vc_shape.post_spatial: xizi_dll head nodes in the selected first Coq-disjunct.
vc_shape.post_exists: none when selecting the first Coq-disjunct.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first Coq-level disjunct. Since first<>head, the segment is nonempty and its abstract list begins with first.
witnesses.space_plan: Regroup head stores into xizi_dll_links and apply xizi_dll_close to the unchanged segment.
witnesses.pure_plan: From first<>head and xizi_dllseg, obtain first=first_value(nodes); combine with the given dispatch equation.
premise_discharge: first<>head is PreH1 and licenses segment unfolding.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Sentinel wrap-around nonempty case shares segment first-value extraction and DLL closing.

vc_shape.post_spatial: For nodes_dispatch_case=nodes_sentinel_case, dispatch precondition ownership plus a wand mapping dispatch post ownership to sentinel post ownership.
vc_shape.post_pure: anchor holds by its sentinel arm; dispatch(head)=first_value(nodes).
vc_shape.post_exists: Choose nodes_dispatch_case=nodes_sentinel_case; inside the wand choose retval equal to the dispatch result/first value.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Instantiate nodes_dispatch_case with nodes_sentinel_case. The wand preserves the incoming xizi_dll resource and changes only the pure return-value presentation.
witnesses.space_plan: Frame the initial DLL into the dispatch precondition. Prove the wand by consuming an arbitrary dispatch post with the same DLL and returning that DLL unchanged.
witnesses.pure_plan: Unfold anchor and choose node=head. Unfold dispatch; Z.eq_dec selects the head branch, so dispatch=first_value(nodes). Rewrite the antecedent retval equation to build the sentinel retval existential.
premise_discharge: The same logical node list is used on both sides, so the DLL resource and first_value argument coincide.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the same dispatch-at-head helper as entail/return sentinel branches and no independent dependency.

vc_shape.post_spatial: For nodes_dispatch_case=nodes_member_case, dispatch precondition ownership plus a wand mapping dispatch post ownership to member post ownership.
vc_shape.post_pure: anchor holds by membership; DLL membership entails query<>head, hence dispatch=next_value(nodes,query).
vc_shape.post_exists: Choose nodes_dispatch_case=nodes_member_case; inside the wand choose retval equal to the dispatch result/next value.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Instantiate nodes_dispatch_case with nodes_member_case. Derive query<>head from membership in the DLL abstract sequence, then preserve the incoming wand DLL resource while rewriting its return equation.
witnesses.space_plan: Use the shared first-occurrence DLL split argument to extract the pure fact query<>head without consuming the logical ownership conclusion. Frame the initial DLL into the dispatch precondition; the wand returns its antecedent DLL unchanged.
witnesses.pure_plan: Choose the membership arm of anchor. The DLL model's nonempty segment guard and disjoint sentinel/member link fields rule out query=head. Unfold dispatch off-head to obtain dispatch=next_value, then rewrite the antecedent retval equality.
premise_discharge: query<>head follows from the DLL segment model: every represented member is in a nonempty branch with node<>stop=head; an equivalent local split proof can derive it.
The same node list is chosen for dispatch and member cases, so both next_value and DLL resources coincide.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Reuses the entail witness's membership decomposition and dispatch-off-head facts.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open or split the circular DLL, derive endpoint/first-occurrence pure facts, simplify dispatch, and either expose or reassemble the same ownership. Derived-call obligations use the same pure facts under a wand.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Local proof assertions provide distinct-link, dllseg split, dllseg join, stop-implies-nil, and segment-first-value entailments; existing xizi_dll_open/xizi_dll_close finish the public predicate conversions.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: First-occurrence decomposition plus next-value computation handles members; unfolding dispatch at equality/disequality handles sentinel/member selection.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall (nodes:list Z) node, In node nodes -> exists before after, nodes=before++node::after /\ ~In node before
forall before node after, ~In node before -> xizi_double_link_next_value (before++node::after) node = xizi_double_link_first_value after
forall nodes head, xizi_double_link_next_dispatch_value nodes head head = xizi_double_link_first_value nodes
forall nodes head node, node<>head -> xizi_double_link_next_dispatch_value nodes head node = xizi_double_link_next_value nodes node

premises.discharged_by: DLL segment member/head exclusion derived from current spatial precondition
premises.spatial_resource: xizi_dll head nodes plus In node nodes

analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All obligations belong to one function, share the same circular-DLL split/join and dispatch helper family, and total only 7 witnesses (below max_witnesses_per_group=12). Keeping them together lets one worker reuse local spatial assertions without introducing cross-group helpers.

candidate_helper_declarations: pure first-occurrence decomposition of list membership
pure next_value equation at the first occurrence
local_proof_assertions: distinct DLL link owners entail distinct node addresses
split xizi_dllseg at a chosen list occurrence
join sentinel links, prefix segment, member links, and suffix segment
xizi_dllseg starting at stop entails an empty abstract list
a non-stopping xizi_dllseg start equals first_value of its abstract list
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the pure list/dispatch helpers in the group-local suffixed case_lib if useful. Within witness bodies, use local spatial assertions modeled on the current xizi_double_link_next reference proof: open/split the DLL for entail_wit_1, select the stronger first Coq-disjunct of each return witness, reassemble with a local join assertion and xizi_dll_close, and prove the two derived calls by instantiating the same nodes and rewriting the wand return equation. Do not promote spatial assertions requiring QCIP/generated imports into case_lib.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_pattern: DLL decomposition/reassembly plus first-occurrence and dispatch simplification; the derived specifications reuse the same facts under a resource-preserving wand.
proving_hints: Use SeparationLogic/examples/OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_double_link_next/source/xizi_double_link_next_proof_manual.v only as the declared non-human reference pattern for split/join assertions.
Select the first Coq-level disjunct for each return_wit_1 through return_wit_4; it retains the complete spatial layout needed to close xizi_dll.
Keep spatial helpers as local assertions in witness proof bodies; case_lib helpers should remain pure and receive the required group-id suffix.
The diagnostic split goals for return_wit_2 and return_wit_3 are hints only and are not assigned witnesses.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: The seven witnesses are below the controller limit of 12 and share one helper family; splitting would either duplicate the DLL join/split work or create a forbidden cross-group helper dependency.
